recentEvents: 2026-10-22/23 Q3 trading update: 9M underlying revenue growth +7% (Risk +8%, STM +6%, Legal +10%, Exhibitions +4%); 2026 outlook reaffirmed (https://www.ariva.de/news/trading-update-october-2026-12177481).
FY2025 (2026-02-12): revenue GBP 9,590m, adjusted operating profit GBP 3,342m (34.8% margin), adjusted EPS 128.5p (+7%), dividend 67.5p (+7%), GBP 1.5bn buybacks; GBP 2.25bn planned for 2026.

2026-02-03: shares fell ~11% (Wolters Kluwer ~9%) after Anthropic released a legal productivity tool for in-house lawyers, sparking AI-disruption fears for data and legal-software businesses (City AM).
valueTrapFlags: No operating deterioration found: underlying growth 7% 9M 2026, margin up ~90bp in FY2025, cash conversion 99%.

Valuation reflects AI-disruption fear rather than reported weakness: shares about 13% lower y/y (stockanalysis, 2026-10-23) after the Feb 2026 sell-off; Legal division (+10%) is the segment most exposed to the narrative.
Leverage drifting up (2.0x vs 1.8x) because buybacks exceed free cash flow after dividends; provider net debt GBP 8.69bn is above company FY2025 GBP 7.2bn.
dataGaps: No forward EPS or adjusted operating profit consensus; forward P/E is provider-only.
H1 2026 company net debt not retrieved; Q3 trading update has no net debt.

valuation.method: Next-12m adjusted EPS x justified P/E. Basis 2026E adjusted EPS 139p (FY2025 128.5p plus guided strong constant-currency growth; lead estimate). Bear weighted 30% for AI disruption of information services. Prices in pence. Historical multiple ranges not verified by agents; justified multiples are lead estimates.

bear.note: Generative AI erodes pricing in legal and risk data; multiple stays compressed. Justified multiple 20x on next-12m 145.95.

base.note: Underlying growth about 7%, margin gains, buybacks: high-single-digit EPS growth. Justified multiple 26x on next-12m 151.51.

bull.note: AI tools lift pricing and usage; multiple returns to pre-2026 levels. Justified multiple 29x on next-12m 154.29.

valuation.whyItFits: Subscription-heavy information and analytics group: adjusted operating margin about 35%, ROIC about 24%, beta 0.27, 9M underlying revenue growth +7% with outlook reaffirmed.
valuation.growthDrivers: Analytics and decision tools (Risk, LexisNexis Legal, Elsevier), generative-AI products layered on proprietary data, steady buybacks.
valuation.saturation: De-rated on AI-disruption fears (shares -11% on 2026-02-03), not on results; about 13% below the 52-week high. Consensus target 3,509p (analyst opinion).
valuation.principalRisk: AI tools commoditising legal and scientific information faster than RELX can monetise its own; 52-week high conflicts between sources.
